## Gnoph-keh (CR 15)

**XP** 51,200  
NE Large magical beast (cold)  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 90 ft., far sight, low-light vision, snow vision, thoughtsense; Perception +29  
**Aura** engrossing  


**Defense**


**AC** 30, touch 12, flat-footed 27 (+3 Dex, +18 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 225 (18d10+126)  
**Fort** +18, **Ref** +16, **Will** +12  
**Defensive Abilities** unobservable movement; **DR** 10/piercing; **Immune** cold, mind-affecting effects; **SR** 26  
**Weaknesses** vulnerable to fire  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +25 (1d8+7), 6 claws +24 (1d6+7/19–20)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** attract attention, death throes, death touch, engrossing, rend (3 claws, 1d6+10)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 15th; concentration +21)  

Constant—greater invisibility  


**Statistics**


**Str** 24, **Dex** 17, **Con** 25, **Int** 6, **Wis** 22, **Cha** 23  
**Base Atk** +18; **CMB** +26; **CMD** 39 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Combat Reflexes, Critical Focus, Improved Critical (claws), Improved Initiative, Improved Lightning Reflexes, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Perception), Staggering Critical, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Perception +29, Stealth +11 (+19 arctic conditions); **Racial Modifiers** +8 Perception, +8 Stealth arctic conditions  
**Languages** Aklo  


**Special Abilities**


**Attract Attention (Su)** As a swift action, a gnoph-keh can attempt to cause a single creature within 120 feet that it can see to be unable to look away from the gnoph-keh.
